Hi Kanika,

I saw the Product Designer opening for Media.net and was drawn to the opportunity to build thoughtful digital products for the US market while balancing technical constraints.

With a background in Computer Science and hands-on experience building reusable design systems at Ascent Business Solutions, I regularly collaborate with developers to bridge the gap between design and code. My technical foundation helps me translate complex requirements into scalable UI patterns.

You can see this in Bounceless, my B2B UX case study demonstrating end-to-end user flows and problem solving, available on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I would love to share a quick look at how my background fits your team. I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai.

Ananya

Hi Chris,

I am applying for the Image Ad Designer role at Jobgether, drawn to the focus on creating high-performing static advertisements and UGC-style creatives for e-commerce brands across Meta platforms.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I produce over one hundred digital and print marketing creatives, building reusable visual templates that cut repetitive work and turnaround time. I also handle print-ready file management, ensuring strict color accuracy, proper sizing, and clean execution across assets.

You can review my social campaign case study for a fashion brand, which demonstrates a fifteen percent increase in follower engagement, alongside my full portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief fifteen-minute call this week to discuss how my execution speed aligns with your e-commerce campaigns?

Ananya
